production.direction_en: Marshal Oren waits at the far end of the bridge with a shield line and Mahmut’s old crest painted upside down.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_mahmut_theme (minor, slow march) facing Oren | battle: bgm_boss_human (commander variation, march snare) | post: bgm_mahmut_theme, solo cello

commands.speaker: marshal_oren
commands.text: I gave the order. I did not know the rite would hollow her out.

commands.speaker: mahmut
commands.text: You knew enough to send men after her.

commands.speaker: marshal_oren
commands.text: I thought the seal would save the kingdom without consuming its heir.

commands.speaker: fadyme
commands.text: You thought a promise was the same as a plan.

commands.speaker: marshal_oren
commands.text: Yseldra carried the order from the Inquisition. I signed it. That is the whole of my courage.
